[SWS_DM_01372] Representation of
DM
by
SOVD
component
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04256
⌈
The DM shall be represented by an SOVD component that shall be a child of the
SOVD Server in the role components. The corresponding component-identifier shall
be derived from the
SovdServerInstantiation
.
⌋
